not_separate_canonical_record_kinds.name: KnownIssue, Retrospective, Memory, Architecture, HowTo, Reference, Explanation, Tutorial
not_separate_canonical_record_kinds.handling: Document subtypes or path families; retain source subtype/fields, do not duplicate same file under an extra canonical identity.

not_separate_canonical_record_kinds.name: FlowNode / FlowStep / Branch
not_separate_canonical_record_kinds.handling: Nested Flow schema members with source-relative identities. Their detailed metadata may use owned subnodes if necessary, not independent top-level source artifacts.

not_separate_canonical_record_kinds.name: Pattern
not_separate_canonical_record_kinds.handling: AC schema declares implements_pattern, pattern_bindings and pattern_slots, but no separate canonical Pattern store/schema was found in the scanned registries/components. Preserve declared fields and references without synthesizing a separate authority.

not_separate_canonical_record_kinds.name: Lesson, Mistake, Observation, Policy
not_separate_canonical_record_kinds.handling: Concept proposal and/or synthetic example types exist, but no independently validated canonical store was found. Do not turn proposed concepts or arbitrary prose into records with invented fields.

not_separate_canonical_record_kinds.name: Flow Markdown, AgentCard, product-truth derived indexes, decision index, roadmap renderings
not_separate_canonical_record_kinds.handling: Generated views of canonical records; avoid duplicate nodes.

not_separate_canonical_record_kinds.name: FeedbackRecord
not_separate_canonical_record_kinds.handling: Runtime JSONL under debugging/logs/feedback.jsonl. Shape owned by templates/scripts/feedback/submit_feedback.py and resolve_feedback.py. Not an immutable Git snapshot source; inventory as a separately governed future runtime ingestion surface.

not_separate_canonical_record_kinds.name: AgentTelemetry, KnowledgeEmission, RunEnvelope, EvidenceBundle, HumanInteraction, CapabilityGap, query activation receipts
not_separate_canonical_record_kinds.handling: Runtime events/transport/checkpoint contracts, not canonical repository record types. Their schema catalog must not be mistaken for Git record inventory.

not_separate_canonical_record_kinds.name: Repository, Snapshot, query catalog indexes, vector labels
not_separate_canonical_record_kinds.handling: Projection/storage metadata, not user-domain canonical record kinds.

not_separate_canonical_record_kinds.name: Configuration/schema definitions, hooks, workflow implementations
not_separate_canonical_record_kinds.handling: SourceFile or Document when referenced, unless a distinct registry record above supplies a native entity contract.

cross_cutting_findings: Current canonical_loader SUPPORTED_SURFACES is exactly acs/adrs/components; expanding display_properties alone cannot recover fields discarded before payload construction or produce missing kinds.

Current Neo4j key derives from repository/generation/canonical_id; future kind expansion needs collision-safe identity because markdown stems, agent ids, skill ids and component ids can overlap. Preserve existing public IDs and make ambiguity explicit rather than silently overwriting.
The docs surface recursively overlaps ADRs, component docs, AC directories, generated flow views and decisions. Specialized source routing/exclusions are necessary before admitting this surface.

Nested maps/lists cannot be assigned as arbitrary Neo4j properties. Per-kind reviewers should identify queryable scalar/list fields and nested flattening or owned-subnode rules, retaining the canonical lossless payload.

Preserve absent versus null versus empty, native booleans/numbers, arrays, source timestamps, source meaning and explicit memberships. Do not infer defaults or component ownership into declared source values.
No exhaustive one-schema-per-type native catalog exists today. This inventory consolidates real schema/validator ownership without claiming schema authority for proposed or transient types.
